tenderSchedule.title: Shifting of BESCOM utilities at ORR from PES College to Laggere Pipeline Road in Package-2 of BMRCL Phase-3 Project.
tenderSchedule.description: The brief scope of work under this tender is Shifting of BESCOM utilities at w-06, N-02, N-08 & N-06 Sub-Divisions which are infringing/ obstructing to construction of Viaduct and Metro Stations all along the ORR from PES College to Laggere Pipeline Road in Corridor-1 of BMRCL Phase-3 Project on Total Turnkey basis which includes Design, Engineering, Manufacturing, Testing, Supply on FOR Destination to Site basis, Transportation, Insurance, Storage, Handling and moving into the final position, Erection, Testing at Site and Commissioning including Civil works.
tenderSchedule.locationName: BMRCL Project Systems Utility Shifiting office Banglore

tenderAddress.blockNumber: O/o the Chief Engineer (U/S), Bengaluru Metro Rail Corporation Limited, Utility Shifting Section, BMRCL Building, 2nd Floor, Deepanjali Nagar,

generalCriterionList.description: The Bidder / consortium partners should possess a valid Class-I/ Super grade Electrical Contractors License issued by Electrical Inspectorate, Government of Karnataka and should be valid on the date of Bid Submission.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

If the Bidder / Consortium participates in more than one enquiry, then the Bidder / Consortium should cumulatively meet Technical and Financial requirements for all the enquiries participated. If the Bidder/Consortium dose not fulfil the cumulative requirements of all the participated enquiries, then the offer of the Bidder / Consortium will be considered to the extent Bidder / Consortium fulfils the cumulative requirement in the order reckoning from the highest amount put to tender.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Bidder / Consortium Partners should be a Registered Sole Proprietorship Firm or a Partnership Firm or a LLP or a Registered Company incorporated under companies Act 1956/2013.

The Bidder / Consortium should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the preceding five years. A consistent history of awards involving litigation against the Bidder or any partner of Consortium may result in rejection of Bid.

The Bidder / Consortium from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the bidder is registered with the competent authority as per Government order No: FD 455 Exp-12 2020 Bengaluru Dated 25.08.2020.

A Certificate for having read the above clauses is required to be submitted / uploaded by the Bidder separately in the following format: I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a bidder of a country which shares a land border with India, I certify that this bidder is not from such a country or, if from such a country, has been registered with the Competent authority. I hereby certify that this bidder fulfills all requirements in this regard and is eligible to be considered. (Where applicable, evidence of valid registration by the competent Authority shall be attached). Note: Government orders No: FD 455 Exp-12 2020 Bengaluru Dated 25.08.2020 and its amendment dated 29.03.2021.

technicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder / any one of consortium partner should have successfully completed as prime contractor, at least one electrical distribution network work such as construction of HT / LT lines, OH/ UG Cable/AB works, erection of distribution transformer/ CSS etc., of value not less than 50% of the estimated value of contract (i.e. amount put to tender) during the previous five financial years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) in any ESCOMs/ Government Electrical Utilities/ Any Government Organization / PSUs. Note: Updated to the FY in which the tenders are invited. The value of the completed works shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the FY in which the tenders are invited.

The Bidder / any one of consortium partner should have commissioned the following minimum quantities of work in any ESCOMs/ Government Electrical Utilities/ Any Government Organization / PSUs in any One year during the previous five financial years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). HT or LT UG Cable: 27.10 KMs RMUs: 38 Nos

At least in any Two financial years the Annual Turnover of the Bidder / Consortium should not be less than Rs. 35.75 Crores during preceding five financial years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). Note: Updated to the FY in which the tenders are invited. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weight of 10 percent per year to bring them to the price level of the FY in which the tenders are invited.

technicalCriterionList.description: The Liquid assets of the Bidder / Consortium as on 21.09.2026 or at a later date before submission of the bid consisting of Cash at Bank plus Term Deposits plus Availability of fund based credit facility in any Nationalized/scheduled Bank should not be lesser than Rs. 4.47 Crores.

Bid capacity is Bidder / Consortium who meets the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under: Assessed available tender capacity is (AxNx1.5-B), A is Maximum value of works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to FY 2026-27 price level), taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N is Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited. B is Value, at FY-2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed in the proposed contract period.
Consortium (Limited to a maximum of Two (2) Constituents including the Lead Bidder) and shall meet the Criteria mentined in ITT CLuase 2.2. (C)(9)
